correctness.rationale: Exact GF restrictions proved from independent geometric multiplicities and Bernoulli overline bits. The microcanonical sharp correction follows from a uniform local Fourier estimate: conditioning on first missing support j shifts earlier geometric variables without changing their variances and removes only size j; mean shift O(t^-1 log), variance change O(t^-2), permitting 1+O(t log²) local ratio. Gaussian/Rayleigh integration and saddle t=(pi/2)sqrt(rho/n) give the stated constant. 520 exact brute-force/cycle-product tests corroborate finite identities only.
